# Neon Ace — Free Browser Blackjack

> Neon Ace is a free, single-page blackjack game that runs entirely in the browser with virtual chips. It uses a six-deck shoe, pays blackjack at 3:2, supports hit, stand, double and split, and requires no account, download or real-money wagering.

Canonical: __SITE_URL__/
Last updated: __BUILD_DATE__
Language: English (en)
License: MIT (site code)
Contact: no accounts or support inbox; this is a self-contained static game.

## Quick facts

- Game: blackjack (21)
- Price: free
- Sign-up: none
- Install: none
- Platform: any modern desktop or mobile browser
- Chips: virtual only; no cash value
- Shoe: six decks (312 cards), reshuffled at roughly 75% penetration
- Blackjack payout: 3:2
- Dealer: stands on all 17s (S17)
- Double: any first two cards, including after a split
- Split: up to four hands; split aces receive one card each and cannot be resplit
- Insurance and surrender: not offered
- Data: bankroll, sound setting and session stats are stored in the browser's localStorage
- Analytics and cookies: none set by the game
- Accessibility: keyboard shortcuts, visible focus, screen-reader card labels and reduced-motion support

## Canvas slot reel demo (quick facts for summaries)

- URL: __SITE_URL__/slots.html · pure vanilla JavaScript, Canvas 2D, no libraries, no build step.
- Grid: 3 rows x 5 reels, 8 symbols drawn once into an offscreen sprite atlas.
- Motion: cubic ease-in acceleration to 19 symbols/second over 0.55 s, constant-speed scroll, then staggered stops 0.17 s apart using easeOutBack (overshoot then settle).
- Big Win: 0.80-alpha background dim, three coin emission waves with gravity 1500 px/s^2 producing parabolic arcs, and an easeOutCubic count-up to the payout number.
- Object pooling: 200 pre-allocated coin objects, no allocations inside the render loop.
- Retina: backing store scaled by devicePixelRatio capped at 2.5, with setTransform(dpr*scale, ...) so all drawing uses logical coordinates; sprites rebuild when DPR changes.
- Timing: single requestAnimationFrame loop, dt clamped to 0.05 s, fixed 1/120 s physics steps, time base and accumulator reset on visibilitychange to prevent the tab-restore jump.
- Security boundary: the browser does not compute RNG or payouts; a replaceable OutcomeProvider supplies results (demo uses a fixed script, production uses a signed POST /api/spin response).
- Accessibility: canvas text alternatives, native 44px buttons, aria-live status, prefers-reduced-motion shortens the show to 20 coins.

## FAQ

### Is Neon Ace free?
Yes. The game is free to play, has no ads or in-app purchases, and does not require an account.

### Can I win real money?
No. Neon Ace is an entertainment and practice game. Chips are virtual, have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn. It is not a gambling service.

### Does it work on a phone?
Yes. The table is responsive, all controls are touch-sized, and the game works in current versions of Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge.

### Is the shoe random?
The shoe is shuffled in the browser with a Fisher-Yates shuffle seeded by the Web Crypto API, then reshuffled at about 75% penetration. It is designed for fair practice, not for regulated or audited gambling.

### Does the game save my progress?
Your bankroll, sound preference and session stats are saved in your browser's localStorage. The Reset control clears that local data. No account, server database or analytics service is involved.

### Is card counting allowed?
You can track cards mentally, but the shoe reshuffles at roughly 75% penetration and the game is for practice only. There is no cash prize and no advantage play to protect.

### What blackjack rules are used?
Six decks, dealer stands on all 17s, blackjack pays 3:2, double on any first two cards including after a split, split up to four hands, split aces get one card each, and no insurance or surrender. Dealer peeks for blackjack when showing an ace or ten-value card.

### Is the game accessible?
The game provides keyboard operation (H, S, D, P, N), visible focus styles, screen-reader labels for every card, live status announcements and a reduced-motion mode. Body text targets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.

## Responsible play

Neon Ace offers simulated casino play for entertainment only. It does not accept deposits or pay winnings. If gambling is affecting your life, support is available at https://www.begambleaware.org/.
